verdict.rationale: Bevy is a game engine, so a visual level editor is a fair question, but the evidence shows no shipped editor with a viewport, inspector or prefab workflow. The pack instead describes a code-first cargo workflow that "needs no editor" and a community user wishing Bevy had "an editor like Godot has." The Scene system (create/save/load ECS worlds) and scene hot-reload are code-driven building blocks, not a visual editor that serves as the primary way to build levels.
